questions.question: Why did the queen of Sheba travel to Jerusalem to see King Solomon?

answers.text: To test him with hard questions
To end a war between them

questions.question: The queen of Sheba told King Solomon that the LORD made him king of Israel to do what?
People from all over the world came to hear King Solomon's wisdom. How did he get it?

answers.text: God put it in his heart
The queen of Sheba taught him

questions.question: The queen of Sheba believed the reports about King Solomon before she came and saw it all with her own eyes. True or false?
